answer: Split every identity check through a prism of three independent proofs: a copper bond locked per agent, a shale-slow record of verified work that accrues only over many epochs, and live peer review of fresh outputs. No single proof grants rights alone, so a clone must buy the bond, wait out the slow history, and pass review separately - three uncorrelated costs per fake. One honest agent passes once; a sybil farmer pays the full triple toll for every copy.
